_note: Consolidated results for Chapter 5 (Simulation Study). All numbers verified against source files on 2026-06-10. Raw values are full precision from results/*/summary.json and experiments/sample_size_comparison.json. Rounded values are to 3 decimal places as they appear in the thesis tables.

architecture_comparison_T1000._description: Test set N=200, T=1000. All NNs use best hyperparameters from random search (84 trials total). stochvol is primary benchmark. NUTS shown for reference only (Uniform priors = idealised conditions).

sample_size_comparison._description: Test set N=200 per T. TCN and Transformer use same hyperparameters as T=1000 search (isolates effect of series length). Transformer T=2000 not run (OOM). stochvol is primary benchmark.

stochvol_rhat._description: Fraction of series with R-hat > 1.1, by parameter and T. mu has zero convergence issues at all T. phi issues concentrate in low-phi series where Beta(7,1) prior conflicts with data — a structural stochvol limitation.

lstm_note: LSTM included in hyperparameter search (9 trials) but proxy task had to be heavily restricted: N=2000 series, sequences truncated to T=200. Best proxy val_loss=0.770 — not comparable to other architectures. Ruled out for full-scale training. Correct thesis framing: computationally infeasible on available hardware.
transformer_T2000_note: Transformer not run at T=2000 — OOM even at batch_size=8. Sample size table therefore shows Transformer at T=500 and T=1000 only.
